## objective
demo video B: 2-minute stills video from the v3 boards of screens that exist in the app, by 19:00
- discovery: HARD DEADLINE: the MP4 must exist within 13 minutes of your start. Speed over polish. Work in a new folder demo-stills/ (own package.json; add demo-stills/ to root eslint ignores and any root tsconfig/vitest includes so the root gate stays green).

Goal: a ~2-minute 1920x1080 30 fps MP4 demo of Alltag made from phone screenshots of ONLY the screens that exist in the app.
1. Screens: the v3 board files in /Users/k3ntaw/code/alltag/.orchestrator/design/v3/project/ (static HTML phone screens, 390x844). Use ONLY these boards (they match screens in src/screens): CameraIdle, CameraScanning, SceneLabels, ObjectSheet, RoleplayStart, RoleplayListening, RoleplayReply, Corrections, ExchangeDone, ReviewQueue, ReviewCard, ReviewResult, RecallTrigger, Diary, StateEmptyReview, ListenIdle, ListenLive, ListenLearn, Settings, SignIn, StateOffline. Do NOT use Onb*, Widget*, Foundations, Motion, Components, Research, Proto*, StateNoMic, StateSlow, VoiceIntro, ListenDiary. If a listed board has no file, skip it.
2. Screenshot each board with headless Chrome (Remotion's browser via `npx remotion browser ensure`, or /Applications/Google Chrome.app with puppeteer-core) at viewport 390x844, deviceScaleFactor 3, after waiting 1200 ms so entry animations settle.
3. Install remotion + @remotion/cli + @remotion/google-fonts in demo-stills/ (download approved by the human). Composition "AlltagStills" 1920x1080: linen #F4F2EE background, an iPhone frame (55 px corners, thin dark bezel, dynamic island) centre-left showing the screenshot with a gentle 3% zoom and a soft cross-fade between shots; right side an eyebrow chip in Geist Mono (feature name), a headline in Instrument Serif, one Geist line on how it works; the Noé orb (gradient #0E5C47, #2FA37F, #BFE8D6, #F0C766) breathing in a corner. Title card ("alltag", "Learn French from the room you are in.") and end card ("Look around. Speak. Remember.", https://alltag-xi.vercel.app, team Kenta).
4. Audio: if /Users/k3ntaw/Downloads/alltag-voiceover.mp3 exists, use it (read only) as the full soundtrack and stretch the sections to it; else make a placeholder with macOS `say -v Samantha` of the same narration and note that in the result. Narration sections and the boards they show (time each section by its word count share of the audio length):
   s01 title card | s02 CameraIdle, CameraScanning, SceneLabels | s03 ObjectSheet | s04 RoleplayStart, RoleplayListening, RoleplayReply | s05 Corrections, ExchangeDone | s06 ReviewQueue, ReviewCard, ReviewResult | s07 RecallTrigger | s08 Diary | s09 ListenIdle, ListenLive, ListenLearn | s10 Settings (offline tutor) | s11 SignIn | s12 StateOffline briefly, then end card.
   The narration text is in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-k3ntaw-code-orchestrator/5466b749-45be-4a0f-829b-0e13d0cf2a89/scratchpad/voiceover.mjs (the text array, s01..s12 in order); copy it, do not change wording. Burn in captions per section.
5. Render with `npx remotion render AlltagStills out/alltag-demo-stills.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20` and copy the result to /Users/k3ntaw/Downloads/alltag-demo-stills.mp4. demo-stills/out and screenshots are gitignored; commit only the code.
Report the output path, duration, and whether the real voice-over or the placeholder was used.

// Alltag demo voice-over: one ElevenLabs call, writes ~/Downloads/alltag-voiceover.mp3.
// Reads ELEVENLABS_API_KEY from the environment only; never prints it.
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { homedir } from "node:os";

const key = process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY;
if (!key) { console.error("ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is not set"); process.exit(1); }
const H = { "xi-api-key": key };

const text = [
  "This is Alltag. You learn French from the room you're in. No lessons, no streaks. Just your phone, what's around you, and Noé, your tutor.",
  "Point the camera at anything. Alltag sends one photo to Gemini vision, and in about three seconds every object gets a French label at your level. Green dots are words you know, yellow ones are due for review, white ones are new.",
  "Tap a label to see the article, the gender, the plural, and a phrase you would actually say right here. One tap keeps it.",
  "Then Noé gives you a small task in that exact scene. Tap talk and just speak. Noé listens and answers out loud in real time, through Gemini Live, and you can interrupt whenever you like.",
  "After the exchange you get calm, typed corrections: what you said, what's better, and why. Every phrase you fumbled goes into your review queue.",
  "Review is spoken, not tapped. You see the English, you say the French, a grader checks it, and spaced repetition decides when it comes back.",
  "And when the camera sees that object again, Noé opens with it, so review happens in real life.",
  "The diary keeps every scene and phrase you kept, by place.",
  "Listen mode is for real conversations. Alltag hears the French around you, shows each line with its English translation, and afterwards picks the phrases worth learning.",
  "No signal? A Gemma 4 model runs on the phone itself, so the tutor still works offline.",
  "Accounts are optional. Sign in to back up your cards to a server in Zurich and get them back on a new phone.",
  "Alltag runs as an iPhone app and on the web, built with Gemini, Gradium voice, Supabase and Vercel. Look around. Speak. Remember.",
].join("\n\n");

async function json(url) {
  const r = await fetch(url, { headers: H });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${url} -> ${r.status}`);
  return r.json();
}

const models = await json("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/models");
const ids = models.filter((m) => m.can_do_text_to_speech !== false).map((m) => m.model_id);
const model = ids.find((i) => /v4/.test(i)) ?? ids.find((i) => i === "eleven_v3") ?? "eleven_multilingual_v2";

const { voices } = await json("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices");
const voice = voices.find((v) => v.name?.startsWith("Sarah")) ?? voices.find((v) => v.category === "premade") ?? voices[0];

console.log(`model ${model}, voice ${voice.name}`);
const r = await fetch(`https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${voice.voice_id}?output_format=mp3_44100_128`, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { ...H, "content-type": "application/json", accept: "audio/mpeg" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ text, model_id: model }),
});
if (!r.ok) { console.error(`tts -> ${r.status} ${(await r.text()).slice(0, 300)}`); process.exit(1); }
const out = `${homedir()}/Downloads/alltag-voiceover.mp3`;
writeFileSync(out, Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()));
console.log(`wrote ${out}`);
